topics.title: Stern & Dice Banner Distraction
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern and his co-hosts discuss an incident where Stern became distracted by a large banner held up during a live segment. The conversation devolves into arguments about audience behavior, personal relationships, accusations of using listeners for ratings, and ultimately, Stern's perceived lack of humor.
